profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading as META. Its website at llama.com describes products and solutions for AI developers, including access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API. The company describes its coding model as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It offers a quick start in under five minutes using an OpenAI SDK compatible client pointed at Meta Model API, search grounding for live web access, and Muse Image on Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing with anchored composition for consistent edits.

Meta offers Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 on a 10-K. Meta is a party in litigation including Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California.
